text:
The net production of ATP by substrate-level phosphorylation in glycolysis is 2 ATP per glucose and 3 ATP per glucosyl unit from glycogen. Glucose spends two ATP in the investment phase and later forms four, for a net of 2. Glycogen enters as glucose 1-phosphate and bypasses the hexokinase step, so only one ATP is invested and the net is 3.

CONFIDENCE: 95
